description: Cartografía actualizada 1:1.000. Túneles is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Executive Council of the Spanish Geographical Information Infrastructure (CODIIGE). Mapping of the City of Madrid updated quarterly integrating different data capture procedures, the main ones being the restitution of photogrammetric flights and topographic surveys. - Reference scale 1:1000 with coverage of the municipality. - Layers of the data model related to Theme 18 - Tunnels. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Updated cartography 1:1,000. Tunnels" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include cartografía actualizada, cartografía urbana, túnel. The listing shows 2025-08-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
